sql: SELECT count(*), count(precio), sum(cantidad), min(precio), max(precio) FROM ventas
SELECT region, count(*) AS n, sum(cantidad * precio) AS total FROM ventas GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
SELECT region, producto, avg(precio) FROM ventas GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT producto, round(avg(cantidad), 2) AS media, median(cantidad), stddev_samp(cantidad), var_pop(cantidad) FROM ventas GROUP BY producto ORDER BY producto
SELECT region, count(DISTINCT producto), count(DISTINCT cliente_id) FROM ventas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT id, precio FROM ventas WHERE precio IS NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM ventas WHERE cantidad BETWEEN 5 AND 7 AND region IN ('Norte', 'Sur') AND producto LIKE '%e%' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM ventas WHERE producto NOT IN ('cafe', 'te') AND precio > 25 ORDER BY precio DESC, id LIMIT 5
SELECT region, sum(cantidad) s FROM ventas GROUP BY region HAVING sum(cantidad) > 700 ORDER BY s DESC
SELECT v.id, c.nombre, c.ciudad FROM ventas v JOIN clientes c ON v.cliente_id = c.cliente_id WHERE v.id <= 10 ORDER BY v.id
SELECT c.cliente_id, count(v.id) AS compras FROM clientes c LEFT JOIN ventas v ON v.cliente_id = c.cliente_id GROUP BY c.cliente_id HAVING count(v.id) = 0 ORDER BY 1
SELECT ciudad, count(*) FROM ventas JOIN clientes USING (cliente_id) GROUP BY ciudad ORDER BY ciudad NULLS FIRST
SELECT p.categoria, sum(v.cantidad) FROM ventas v JOIN productos p ON v.producto = p.sku GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT id, cantidad, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY cantidad DESC, id) rn, rank() OVER (ORDER BY cantidad DESC) rk, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY cantidad DESC) dr FROM ventas ORDER BY rn LIMIT 15
SELECT id, region, cantidad, sum(cantidad) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY id) AS acum FROM ventas ORDER BY region, id LIMIT 20
SELECT id, cantidad, lag(cantidad) OVER (ORDER BY id) ant, lead(cantidad, 2, -1) OVER (ORDER BY id) sig FROM ventas ORDER BY id LIMIT 10
SELECT id, avg(cantidad) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS movil FROM ventas ORDER BY id LIMIT 12

SELECT region, id, first_value(id) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY cantidad, id) f, last_value(id) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY cantidad, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) l FROM ventas ORDER BY region, id LIMIT 12
SELECT id, ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY id) q, percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY cantidad) pr, cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY cantidad) cd FROM ventas ORDER BY id LIMIT 10
SELECT region, producto, sum(cantidad) s, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sum(cantidad) DESC) r FROM ventas GROUP BY region, producto QUALIFY r <= 2 ORDER BY region, r, producto
SELECT id FROM ventas QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY producto ORDER BY precio DESC NULLS LAST, id) = 1 ORDER BY id
WITH t AS (SELECT cliente_id, sum(cantidad) q FROM ventas GROUP BY cliente_id) SELECT count(*), max(q), min(q) FROM t
WITH a AS (SELECT region, sum(cantidad) s FROM ventas GROUP BY region), b AS (SELECT avg(s) m FROM a) SELECT region FROM a, b WHERE s > m ORDER BY region
SELECT id FROM ventas WHERE precio > (SELECT avg(precio) FROM ventas) AND cantidad > 18 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, cantidad FROM ventas v WHERE cantidad = (SELECT max(cantidad) FROM ventas w WHERE w.region = v.region) ORDER BY id
SELECT nombre FROM clientes c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ventas v WHERE v.cliente_id = c.cliente_id AND v.cantidad = 20) ORDER BY nombre
SELECT cliente_id FROM clientes WHERE cliente_id NOT IN (SELECT cliente_id FROM ventas) ORDER BY 1
SELECT producto FROM ventas WHERE region = 'Norte' UNION SELECT producto FROM ventas WHERE region = 'Sur' ORDER BY 1
SELECT cliente_id FROM ventas WHERE region = 'Norte' INTERSECT SELECT cliente_id FROM ventas WHERE region = 'Sur' ORDER BY 1
SELECT cliente_id FROM clientes EXCEPT SELECT cliente_id FROM ventas ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT region FROM ventas UNION ALL SELECT region FROM ventas)
SELECT DISTINCT region FROM ventas ORDER BY region DESC
SELECT id, CASE WHEN cantidad > 15 THEN 'alta' WHEN cantidad > 5 THEN 'media' ELSE 'baja' END AS nivel FROM ventas ORDER BY id LIMIT 8
SELECT upper(producto) || '-' || region, length(producto), substr(region, 2, 3), replace(producto, 'e', 'E') FROM ventas ORDER BY id LIMIT 5
SELECT coalesce(ciudad, 'sin ciudad') c, count(*) FROM clientes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT year(fecha), month(fecha), count(*) FROM ventas GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 6
SELECT date_trunc('month', fecha) AS mes, sum(cantidad) FROM ventas GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes LIMIT 5
SELECT CAST(precio AS INTEGER), precio::VARCHAR, cantidad / 4, cantidad // 4, cantidad % 4 FROM ventas WHERE precio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 6
SELECT abs(-3), round(2.567, 1), floor(-1.5), ceil(1.2), sqrt(16), power(2, 10), 7 % 3, -7 % 3, greatest(1, 5, 3), least(4, 2), nullif(1, 1), sign(-5)
SELECT string_agg(sku, ',' ORDER BY sku) FROM productos
SELECT categoria, string_agg(sku, '|' ORDER BY stock DESC) FROM productos GROUP BY categoria ORDER BY categoria
SELECT arg_max(id, cantidad), arg_min(region, precio), bool_or(cantidad > 19), bool_and(cantidad > 0) FROM ventas
SELECT region, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cantidad > 10) grandes, sum(cantidad) FILTER (WHERE producto = 'cafe') cafe FROM ventas GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
SELECT quantile_cont(precio, 0.25), quantile_cont(precio, 0.9) FROM ventas
SELECT vip, count(*) FROM clientes GROUP BY vip ORDER BY vip
SELECT * FROM productos ORDER BY sku
SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 'uno'), (2, 'dos')) t(n, nombre) ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT range FROM range(5)
SELECT count(*) FROM ventas v1 JOIN ventas v2 ON v1.cliente_id = v2.cliente_id AND v1.id < v2.id
SELECT r.region, s.producto FROM (SELECT DISTINCT region FROM ventas) r CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT producto FROM ventas) s ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 7
SELECT c.cliente_id, v.id FROM clientes c FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM ventas WHERE id < 5) v ON c.cliente_id = v.cliente_id ORDER BY c.cliente_id NULLS LAST, v.id NULLS LAST LIMIT 8
SELECT id, sum(cantidad) OVER w FROM ventas WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id LIMIT 3
SELECT region, max(cantidad) - min(cantidad) AS rango, count(*) * 2 FROM ventas GROUP BY region ORDER BY rango DESC, region
SELECT id, sum(cantidad) OVER (ORDER BY cantidad RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM ventas ORDER BY id LIMIT 6
SELECT producto, sum(sum(cantidad)) OVER () total, sum(cantidad) * 100.0 / sum(sum(cantidad)) OVER () pct FROM ventas GROUP BY producto ORDER BY producto
SELECT id FROM ventas WHERE producto ILIKE 'CA%' AND id < 40 ORDER BY id
SELECT trim('  hola  '), lpad('7', 3, '0'), split_part('a-b-c', '-', 2), starts_with('hola', 'ho'), contains('hola', 'ol'), reverse('abc'), concat('a', NULL, 'b')
SELECT id FROM ventas ORDER BY precio NULLS FIRST, id LIMIT 4
SELECT id FROM ventas ORDER BY precio DESC, id LIMIT 3 OFFSET 2
